Delete your account

You can delete your Roam account in the app or request help without reinstalling it.

Delete in Roam

  1. Open Profile → Privacy & account.
  2. Tap Delete account.
  3. Follow the confirmation steps.

If you own a group, arrange a handover first if Roam asks you to. A backup owner can take over.

Request deletion by email

Use the subject Delete my Roam account and tell us which account you use to sign in. We may need to verify that the account is yours. Keep passwords and sign-in codes private.

[Support email — request address pending]

What happens after deletion

Account deletion is permanent. Your account and profile are removed. If a Secret Santa draw already happened, the exchange can keep a reference without your name or email so existing assignments stay intact.
